author: devbig030
body: [muse watermelon-full-preview] Delivered on main (45a038f7 stack): a chat bridge whose provider gap stood at least 10 minutes approves its own checkpoint-only or exact-committed retry at startup, writing downtime evidence into the same gap-retries audit an operator approval writes; cursor kept so provider replay backfills the outage window. Fresh gaps and changed boundaries/configurations still refuse to the operator path. Misleading start message fixed: search-path lists are no longer reported as missing credential files, and credential lines name the environment variable as a variable. Tests: outage_gap_auto_resolves_only_after_the_downtime_threshold, a_search_path_list_is_not_a_missing_credential_file; full agentctl Rust suite (1929) and cross differential passed in gate.
